title: antillanthus moldenkei
intro: Antillanthus moldenkei, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a species of flowering plant in the sunflower family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The health benefits of Antillanthus moldenkei include its antimicrobial and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
